callouts.label: Castle Climb
callouts.hint: Children climb a low castle wall above safety mats.
callouts.description: Climbing builds muscles, grip, coordination, and confidence.
callouts.ap_tip: Choose a route that matches your body and use safe equipment.

callouts.label: Ribbon Dance
callouts.hint: Children dance together beneath colorful ribbons.
callouts.description: Dancing moves the whole body and can lift mood and release stress.
callouts.ap_tip: There is no single correct way to dance.

callouts.label: Rolling Obstacle Course
callouts.hint: A child using a sports wheelchair moves through colorful obstacles.
callouts.description: Wheeling quickly can build endurance, steering skill, and confidence.
callouts.ap_tip: Inclusive play gives every child a meaningful challenge.

callouts.label: Animal Stretches
callouts.hint: Children stretch in animal-like poses in a meadow.
callouts.description: Stretching gently practices flexibility, balance, focus, and calm breathing.
callouts.ap_tip: A stretch should feel gentle, not painful.

callouts.label: Team Ball Pass
callouts.hint: Children pass a blue ball around a circle.
callouts.description: Cooperative ball play builds coordination, attention, and teamwork.
callouts.ap_tip: Success means helping the whole group keep the ball moving.

callouts.label: Stepping-Stone Jumps
callouts.hint: Children jump across bright round stones.
callouts.description: Jumping develops leg strength, balance, and body control.
callouts.ap_tip: Look where you plan to land.

callouts.label: Low-Log Balance
callouts.hint: A child balances along a low log while friends watch.
callouts.description: Balancing trains core muscles, focus, and steady movement.
callouts.ap_tip: Move at your own pace and step down when needed.

callouts.label: Helmeted Scooters
callouts.hint: Children ride scooters along a looping path wearing helmets.
callouts.description: Scooting develops leg strength, coordination, and endurance.
callouts.ap_tip: Helmets and a clear path protect riders and others.

callouts.label: Water and Recovery
callouts.hint: Children rest in shade and drink water.
callouts.description: Rest and hydration help the body recover after active play.
callouts.ap_tip: Active time and recovery time both belong in a healthy day.
